title: Project AGAP Wind Hazard Reference Matrix
classification_source: DOST-PAGASA Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal guidance and tropical cyclone classification references
notes: This matrix is a general preparedness reference, not an engineering damage model, official warning, or evacuation order.
The sustained_wind_kph_range is [minimum, maximum]. A null maximum means the category has no upper bound in this data contract.
Do not convert a cyclone category directly into an official Tropical Cyclone Wind Signal (TCWS). PAGASA issues TCWS by affected land area, expected wind threat, and warning lead time.

Use current PAGASA, Quezon City, and other relevant authorities' advisories for time-sensitive protective actions. Review all wording with local disaster-management personnel before public deployment.

wind_hazard_matrix.relative_threat_level: Lower relative wind-hazard band; conditions remain location-dependent

structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Loose tarpaulins, canopies, or light outdoor fixtures may be displaced
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Secure loose outdoor items before conditions worsen, but only while it is safe to do so.

structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Weak branches may break, especially where trees are damaged or soil is saturated
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Keep clear of damaged trees and branches; report dangerous conditions to local authorities.

wind_hazard_matrix.relative_threat_level: Elevated wind hazard; local impacts vary

structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Poorly secured or deteriorated materials may loosen
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Secure or bring in loose outdoor items before strong winds arrive. Do not climb onto roofs during hazardous weather.

structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Lightweight yard items and unsecured debris may be blown around
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Move outdoor furniture and loose materials indoors before conditions become dangerous.

structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Falling branches or damaged structures may affect utility lines
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Stay well clear of fallen or sagging wires and report them to the appropriate utility or emergency authority.

wind_hazard_matrix.relative_threat_level: High wind hazard; significant local damage is possible

structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Deteriorated roofs and poorly connected components may fail
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Follow official preparedness and evacuation instructions. Do not attempt roof repairs while winds or rain are hazardous.

structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Flying debris and wind pressure can damage glazing and openings
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Close shutters if fitted before hazardous conditions arrive and keep away from windows during strong winds.

structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Fallen branches and damaged equipment may cause outages or exposed electrical hazards
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Prepare for possible power interruptions. Never touch downed lines or damaged electrical equipment.

wind_hazard_matrix.relative_threat_level: Very high wind hazard; severe local impacts are possible

structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Light-material structures and poorly secured components may suffer serious damage
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Follow official guidance on sheltering or evacuation and move to an approved shelter before travel becomes unsafe.

structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Roofing sheets, branches, and unsecured materials may become dangerous projectiles
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Remain indoors in a suitable sheltered location during dangerous winds and stay away from windows.

structural_vulnerabilities.element: Trees, utility poles, and overhead lines
structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Trees or infrastructure may fall and block roads or expose electrical hazards
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Avoid blocked roads and damaged infrastructure. Report hazards; do not approach or move fallen wires.

wind_hazard_matrix.relative_threat_level: Extreme wind hazard; catastrophic impacts may occur in exposed or vulnerable locations

structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Severe structural damage or failure is possible, especially in vulnerable structures
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Follow official evacuation or shelter instructions promptly. Use only designated shelters and routes identified as safe by authorities.

structural_vulnerabilities.element: Power, communications, and other critical utilities
structural_vulnerabilities.risk: Widespread service disruption and hazardous damaged infrastructure may occur
structural_vulnerabilities.action: Prepare for communications and power interruptions. Use verified emergency contacts and avoid damaged utility infrastructure.
